entry.name: Google AI Essentials
entry.note: A course certificate, not a proctored exam; a non-technical introduction to using generative AI at work
entry.audience: Anyone in a non-technical role who wants working fluency with generative AI

covers: Using generative AI tools to develop ideas and content
Using AI responsibly by identifying biases and avoiding harm
Developing strategies to stay up-to-date in AI
Explaining how AI functions at a basic level
Describing capabilities and limitations of AI tools
reading.format: Self-paced program with hands-on activities. Learners solve workplace tasks using AI and earn a certificate from Google after completion.
reading.summary: Google AI Essentials is a self-paced program that teaches people across roles and industries how to use AI tools to boost productivity. It requires no prior experience and is taught by AI experts at Google. Completing the program earns a certificate from Google.
reading.audience: The page says it is for people across roles and industries who are new to AI and want to speed up daily tasks and spark new ideas. Zero experience is required.
